label: Person full name
description: A person's full name, e.g. 'Ivan Petrov', 'Иванов Иван Иванович', '王伟'.

label: Given name
description: A person's first / given name only.

label: Surname
description: A person's last name / family name only.

label: Patronymic
description: A patronymic or middle name, e.g. 'Ivanovich', 'Петровна'.

label: Date of birth
description: A person's birth date.

label: Age
description: A person's age in years.

label: Gender
description: Sex or gender: M/F, male/female, муж/жен.

label: Nationality
description: Citizenship or nationality, e.g. 'Russian', 'French', 'Iran'.

label: Occupation / role
description: A job title, position, rank or role.

label: Organization name
description: A company, agency, bank, university or other organization name.

label: Registration number
description: A company registration number (OGRN, company number).

label: Tax id
description: A taxpayer id such as INN, VAT or EIN.

label: Industry / category
description: An organization's sector, industry or type.

label: Full address
description: A full street or postal address in one cell.

label: Street
description: A street name, optionally with house number.

label: House number
description: A building or house number.

label: Apartment / unit
description: An apartment, flat, suite or unit number.

label: Postal code
description: A postal or ZIP code.

label: City
description: A city, town or village name.

label: Region / state
description: A state, province, oblast or other first-level region.

label: Country
description: A country name.

label: Country code
description: A 2-3 letter country code such as RU, US, IRN.

label: Place name
description: A named place, facility or landmark that is not an address.

label: Latitude
description: Latitude in decimal degrees or DMS.

label: Longitude
description: Longitude in decimal degrees or DMS.

label: Coordinate pair
description: A latitude/longitude pair in one cell, e.g. '55.75, 37.61'.

label: Geohash / MGRS
description: A geohash or MGRS grid reference.

label: Phone number
description: A telephone or mobile number.

label: Email address
description: An email address.

label: IP address
description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address.

label: IBAN / bank account
description: An IBAN or bank account number.

label: Payment card
description: A payment card number.

label: Passport number
description: A passport number or MRZ.

label: National id
description: A national identity number (SNILS, code melli, resident id).

label: IMEI
description: A device IMEI.

label: IMSI
description: A SIM IMSI.

label: Social handle
description: A social-media or messenger handle or profile.

label: Crypto address
description: A cryptocurrency wallet address.

label: License plate
description: A vehicle registration plate.

label: Domain / website
description: A website domain or URL.

label: MAC address
description: A network hardware (MAC) address.

label: Date
description: A calendar date of an event or record.

label: Date and time
description: A timestamp with date and time.

label: Unix timestamp
description: Seconds or milliseconds since 1970.

label: Time of day
description: A time of day without a date.

label: Duration
description: A duration such as call length in seconds or hh:mm:ss.

label: Amount
description: A money amount or other quantity.

label: Currency
description: A currency code or symbol, e.g. USD, RUB, €.

label: Direction
description: Incoming/outgoing, sent/received, debit/credit.

label: Count
description: A count of events or items.

label: Relationship label
description: How two parties relate, e.g. 'father', 'employee', 'spouse'.

label: Row id
description: A unique record identifier or sequence number.

label: Reference id
description: An id referring to a record elsewhere (account id, case number).

label: Free text
description: Notes, comments, message bodies or descriptions.

label: Boolean flag
description: Yes/no, true/false, 0/1 flags.

label: Category
description: A small set of repeated labels or statuses.

label: Other
description: Anything else.
